name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage the renovation myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage the renovation myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between hiring a general contractor and managing the renovation yourself involves a significant practical tradeoff. A general contractor brings experience, established relationships with subcontractors, and handles scheduling, permits, and quality control, saving you time and potential headaches. However, this convenience comes with a cost. Self-managing can save money on contractor fees but requires a significant time commitment, knowledge of construction processes, and the ability to coordinate various trades. Consider your own experience level, available time, and the complexity of the project in areas like Caldwell or Nampa when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a general contractor saves time and stress but costs more; self-managing can save money but requires significant time and construction knowledge.
